summary: Authenticated frontend regression for DynoPay 'Needs attention' ack + notifications-restore + confetti-removal. All 3 requested tests PASS on brand 1 (The Dev Store). T1: dashboard initially listed non-critical attention rows [attention-expired-today, attention-links-expiring]; picked attention-expired-today, clicked its data-testid=attention-feed-action-btn (navigated to /transactions?status=unpaid&range=today), returned to /dashboard — row was GONE, localStorage 'dyno_attention_ack' = {"expired":{"fp":"expired:1:49.98","at":...}} (24h TTL ack keyed by item.id per useAttentionItems.acknowledge), and row remained GONE after a full reload. T2: /notifications rendered the acknowledged row at data-testid=notifications-attention-attention-expired-today with data-dismissed='true' plus data-testid=notifications-attention-attention-expired-today-restore ('Show on dashboard'); after click, /dashboard shows the row again and 'dyno_attention_ack' becomes {} (entry removed by restore()). T3: no <canvas> with computed position:'fixed' on /dashboard initial render, after brand switches 1→165→71→1 (each +3s dwell), or on /transactions (+3s). Total canvases observed on all snapshots = 0 (dashboard trend chart canvas hadn't fully painted at snapshot time, but importantly there is no fullscreen fixed confetti canvas anywhere). Confetti fully absent from these surfaces — matches spec (confetti now only in onboarding).
critical_code_review_comments: TwoFactorLoginDialog passes no testIdPrefix to OtpInputPanel, so the six OTP boxes in the login 2FA dialog have NO data-testid attributes (OtpInputPanel guards with `testIdPrefix ? ... : undefined`). Adds friction for automated tests; consider passing e.g. testIdPrefix='login-2fa' so login-2fa-otp-input-1..6 exist (matches the documented convention used elsewhere).

Notification row testid duplicates the 'attention-' prefix: data-testid=notifications-attention-attention-expired-today (item.testId already starts with 'attention-'). Consider stripping the prefix or using item.id for cleaner ids (`notifications-attention-expired-today`).

seed_data_creation: None. Only sessionStorage.mfa_interstitial_seen=1 (to skip interstitial) and read/write to localStorage 'dyno_attention_ack' via the app itself. Cleared any prior ack at test start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login 2FA dialog OTP boxes have no data-testid — use `[data-testid="login-2fa-dialog"] input` (first input) and page.keyboard.type(code). Attention items rely on live data; brand 1 currently shows only non-critical rows (attention-expired-today, attention-links-expiring, attention-claim-handle depending on state) — 'attention-claim-handle' disappears once the merchant handle is claimed. Ack in localStorage is keyed by item.id (e.g., 'expired', 'expiring', 'handle'), NOT by testId — restore selector on /notifications uses testId (data-testid=notifications-attention-<testId>-restore). Notification row testid double-prefixes: notifications-attention-attention-<name>. Preview dev server may 502 briefly on recompile — retry after ~10s.
rca of the issue: N/A — all three flows work as designed. Bug fixes verified: (1) acknowledge writes 24h ACK to dyno_attention_ack keyed by item.id, hides row on dashboard, survives reload; (2) notifications mirrors acked row with data-dismissed='true' + restore button that clears the ack entry and brings row back on dashboard; (3) no full-viewport (position:fixed) canvas is mounted on dashboard, brand switches, or /transactions — confetti effect has been removed from those surfaces.
